name: Backendless
line: Build apps with a database, auth, file storage, realtime, and logic.

free.text: 1 GB files, 1,000 requests/day; inactive apps may end after 2 months

cells.regions: North America, South America, and Europe endpoints

sql.math: Fixed Tier 1 at the stated pace. Table size, connection fit, traffic bursts and transfer are still uncertain.
A fixed $15 base even with zero calls. Resources that are kept, and inactivity limits, still apply.

files.math: $55 for Tier 4, plus nine 10 GB packs at $20 each. Transfer and other fees are not known, so they are not included.

jobs.math: Trigger requests can fit within the free pool if they are paced. Worker CPU, memory and concurrency are unknown.
